data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable passcode input screen that mimics native iOS behavior. It supports callbacks for passcode entry, validation, cancellation, and can be styled via colors, sizes, and custom widgets.
use_when: You need a simple passcode lock screen for authentication or secure sections of an app
You want a ready-made, null-safe widget that works on mobile, web, and desktop
You need customizable UI elements like cancel/delete buttons and keyboard layout
avoid_when: You require biometric authentication or multi-factor login flows
You need a full authentication framework with backend integration
You want a lightweight solution that only needs a simple dialog
strengths: Highly customizable UI via color, size, and widget parameters
Platform agnostic with no native configuration required
Supports web and desktop keyboard listeners
Null safety and up-to-date with Flutter 2+
weaknesses: Limited to passcode input only, no biometric or OAuth support
No built-in navigation handling beyond callbacks
Requires manual stream handling for validation
